final: WITH member_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) as member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), total_members AS (SELECT SUM(member_count) as total FROM member_counts) SELECT mc.link_to_major, mc.member_count, CAST(mc.member_count AS REAL) / CAST(tm.total AS REAL) as share FROM member_counts mc CROSS JOIN total_members tm ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10
